KEY FACTS:
- NASA has a goal of transferring at least three technologies to small businesses by the end of FY 2025.
- As of September 2024, NASA's list of construction repairs is at an estimated $5.4 billion.
- NASA's recapitalization liability has grown to an estimated $9 billion.
- NASA intends to award 30 Teams Engaging Affiliated Museums and Informal Institutions (TEAM II) Community Anchors and National Connectors over the next two fiscal years.
